title: Version and updates
descDesk: This app keeps itself up to date.
descServer: You run this app on your own server.
latestNone: You have the latest version. No newer release has been published yet.
serverHow2: in Docker Desktop, Portainer or Dockhand. In a terminal:
installing: Closing the app to install version {v}. It opens again by itself in a moment.
ready: Version {v} is ready. Restart the app to finish updating. Your data stays as it is.
error: Could not check for updates right now.
errorNeed: The server needs internet access to github.com.
dev: Updates apply to the installed app.
autoD: Download and install new versions by itself. It installs the next time you close the app.
instD: Optional. Gives the app its own icon and window, and it opens even without a connection.
instHint: Install it for a full-screen app icon on this device.

dlD.win: Keeps your data on this computer, or connects to your own server. Free, from GitHub.
dlD.mac: Keeps your data on this Mac, or connects to your own server. Free, from GitHub. Pick the file for your Mac's chip: Apple menu, then About This Mac. The first time, allow it in System Settings, Privacy and Security, Open Anyway.
dlD.linux: Keeps your data on this computer, or connects to your own server. Free, from GitHub. Pick the file that fits your system.
dlD.android: An app for your Android phone, with a fingerprint lock and alerts as phone notifications.
dlD.ios: There is no app to download for iPhone or iPad. Added to the Home Screen, it works like an app.

deskMacArm: Download for Apple chip (M1 and newer)
appD: The Money Manager app on this phone.
appNew: Version {v} of the app is available
appGetD: Download the newest file from GitHub and open it to update. Your server and your data are not touched.
hereD: This device: {d}. Installing is optional: the app gets its own icon and window, and opens even without a connection.
doneD: The app is already installed on this device.

how.win: In Chrome or Edge: open the browser menu, then Install app.
how.mac: In Safari: File, then Add to Dock. In Chrome: the browser menu, then Install app.
how.linux: In Chrome or Edge: open the browser menu, then Install app.
how.android: In Chrome: open the browser menu, then Add to home screen.
how.ios: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

get.mac: Or download the Mac app (Apple chip or Intel chip).
get.ios: There is no app to download for iPhone or iPad.

otherD: The app works on these too. Open this same address on the device, then follow the steps.
appNewD: Download it here, then install it. Your server and your data are not touched.
appReady: Version {v} is downloaded and ready to install. Android asks you to confirm.

appErr.updFailed: The download did not finish. Check the internet connection and try again.
appErr.updDamaged: The downloaded file was not right, so it was deleted. Try again.
appErr.updAllow: Allow Money Manager to install updates in the window that opened, then tap Install again.
